title: Xiao Zhu Pei Qi: Wanmei Jiaqi
synopsis:
When Peppa found out that the family wouldn't be going on holiday this year, she felt completely crushed. But then a sudden storm swept in and carried her all the way to far-off China! Peppa unlocked one amazing adventure after another along the way—and by the time she was reunited with her family, she'd had the most perfect holiday ever.

(Source: Douban, translated)
